chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Amr ibn Thabit, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

There was a woman called Umm Tayba who used to circumcise the girls. So the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) called her and said to her: 'O Umm Tayba! When you circumcise the girls, scrape lightly and do not overdo it, for it is cleaner for the complexion of the face and more pleasurable for the husband.'

key_terms.وَلَا تُجْحِفِي: and do not overdo it / do not be harsh

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method for female circumcision according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) advises Umm Taybah, a female hairdresser, to perform *khitan al-jawari* (female circumcision) by lightly scraping the clitoral glans rather than removing it entirely, a practice known as *ashm* in Shia jurisprudence. This guidance emphasizes moderation to preserve hygiene ('cleanest for the face') and maximize marital pleasure ('most pleasing to the husband'), reflecting the Shia view that the procedure is recommended but not obligatory, and should avoid excessive harm.
